findings.title: Repeated localStorage reads on every HTTP request without memoization
findings.description: The RequestInterceptor reads from localStorage on every single HTTP request. The token and email values are read synchronously from localStorage on every request, causing unnecessary I/O overhead. These values could be cached in memory after first access.
findings.suggested_fix: Cache the token and email values in module-level variables or use a BehaviorSubject in an AuthService. Only update the cache when the token actually changes.

findings.title: Unbounded list queries without pagination on Products API endpoint
findings.description: The /api/Products endpoint returns all products without pagination. Tests verify that all products are returned (products.length) with no limit/offset parameters. This will cause performance degradation as the product catalog grows.
findings.suggested_fix: Add pagination support to the Products endpoint: include limit and offset/page query parameters, default to reasonable limits (e.g., 20 items), and return total count for pagination UI.

findings.title: Unbounded list queries without pagination on Feedbacks API endpoint
findings.description: The /api/Feedbacks endpoint returns all feedback without pagination, similar to Products. This will cause memory and performance issues with large feedback datasets.
findings.suggested_fix: Add pagination support to the Feedbacks endpoint with limit and offset/page parameters.

findings.title: Unbounded list queries without pagination on Users API endpoint
findings.description: The /api/Users endpoint returns all users without pagination. This is a security and performance concern - exposing all user data and causing memory issues with large user bases.
findings.suggested_fix: Add pagination to the Users endpoint with limit and page parameters, plus server-side filtering capabilities.

findings.title: Expensive reduce operation on config products array in test
findings.description: The productReviewApiSpec performs a reduce operation on config.get<Product[]>('products') to count reviews. If this config is accessed repeatedly without caching, it causes unnecessary computation.
findings.suggested_fix: Cache the product config at module level or before the test suite to avoid repeated config access.

findings.title: Nested promise chains without parallel execution in data export tests
findings.description: The dataExportApiSpec has multiple sequential .then() chains that could be parallelized. For example, login followed by data export could run login once and reuse the token.
findings.suggested_fix: Use Promise.all() to run independent API calls in parallel where applicable, or cache auth tokens for reuse across multiple test cases.

findings.title: Missing eager loading for related data in API responses
findings.description: API endpoints like basket with products likely perform N+1 queries - fetching basket then iterating to fetch each product separately. The test verifies Products are loaded but doesn't show efficient loading.
findings.suggested_fix: Implement eager loading using Sequelize's include option or Mongoose's populate() to fetch related products in a single query rather than N+1 queries.

pass_results.pass_summary: Found 7 error handling issues: 1 critical (unhandled file I/O), 2 high (error detail leakage, missing Angular error boundary), 3 medium (ineffective handlers, empty error responses), 1 low (redundant catch block).
